title: Keep the phone awake with an F24 user-activity watcher, not the Stay awake setting
context: Owner, 2026-09-24: "Make sure the phone screen doesn't sleep. Keep it awake. Test fully." The phone has a secure lock (dumpsys window: secure=true); after the 30 s screen timeout it locks and only the owner can unlock (the agent never enters a PIN). The probe's FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON covers only the probe window, not the camera, the photo picker or the share sheet. Measured: KEYCODE_WAKEUP does not reset lastUserActivityTime; KEYCODE_F24 and keycode 0 do, and neither produced a probe error.
options: svc power stayon usb (changes the Stay awake developer setting)
Watcher that injects KEYCODE_F24 every 6 s whenever the focused window is not the probe, and logs any screen-off
Rely on the probe flag alone and ask the owner to unlock when it locks
outcome: Watcher with KEYCODE_F24 (scratchpad keepawake.zsh, log keepawake.log). It changes no system setting and pokes only when another app is in front, so it cannot interleave with probe typing tests. Stop it at the end of the session. If the log shows a screen-off, the owner has to unlock.
